title: Audit log
intro: Who changed what in your organization, when, and from where.
empty: Nothing has been recorded yet. Changes to staff, roles and settings appear here as people make them.
emptyRecord: Nothing has been recorded about this record.
recordHistory: {kind, select, member {This staff member's history} role {This role's history} organization {The organization's history} subscription {The subscription's history} issued_document {This document's history} lead {This lead's history} person {This customer's history} task {This follow-up or task's history} destination {This destination's history} other {This record's history}}
oneRecord: {kind, select, member {The history of one staff member} role {The history of one role} organization {The organization's history} subscription {The subscription's history} issued_document {The history of one document} lead {The history of one lead} person {The history of one customer} task {The history of one follow-up or task} destination {The history of one destination} other {The history of one record}}

staff.invited: Invited a staff member to choose a password
staff.password-reset: Gave a staff member a new temporary password

settings.two-factor-requirement-changed: Changed whether everyone must use two-factor sign-in

support.impersonation-started: Started signing in as a staff member
support.impersonation-stopped: Stopped signing in as a staff member

subscription.overrides-changed: Changed the subscription's extra seats, price or modules
subscription.paid-through-changed: Changed the date the subscription is paid until
subscription.status-changed: Moved the subscription to its next state

subject.erased: Erased a person's or record's personal data

person.edited: Changed a customer's name or contacts

lead.repeat-enquiry: Added a repeat enquiry to a lead
lead.note-added: Added a note to a lead
lead.stage-changed: Moved a lead to another stage
lead.reassigned: Gave a lead to another owner

task.done: Marked a follow-up or task done
task.reassigned: Gave a follow-up or task to someone else

import.started: Started adding the rows of an import
import.finished: Finished adding the rows of an import
import.report-downloaded: Downloaded an import's rows not added

sheet.columns-changed: Matched a Google Sheet's columns again
sheet.access-lost: Lost access to a Google Sheet
sheet.tab-missing: Found a Google Sheet's tab missing
sheet.columns-missing: Found columns missing from a Google Sheet
sheet.needs-manager: Found a Google Sheet without a manager
sheet.access-restored: Regained access to a Google Sheet
sheet.recovered: A Google Sheet is working again
sheet.problem-hidden: Hid a row a Google Sheet couldn't add

assignment.updated: Changed how new leads are assigned

website-form.embed-changed: Changed whether the website form can be put on a website
